training_use.value: Your content is not used to improve the base models.

shared_with_model_provider.value: Your content is not shared with any model providers.

provider_access.value: Models run in Model Deployment Accounts operated by the Amazon Bedrock service team; model providers have no access to those accounts, their logs, or customer prompts and completions.

abuse_monitoring.value: Automated abuse detection, under a zero operator access model; for some models Bedrock stores inputs and outputs for a limited time, as the abuse detection page lists per model.

encryption.value: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, optionally with your own keys.
